items.name: Packed Lunch
items.text: Out of battle only. Restores 20% of one character's max HP and sheds 3 stress. Only the first lunch a character eats after each rest sheds stress.

items.name: Pick-Me-Up
items.text: Restores 30% of one ally's max HP, up to 5,700 HP.

items.name: Proper Pick-Me-Up
items.text: Restores 30% of one ally's max HP, up to 39,000 HP.

items.name: Serious Pick-Me-Up
items.text: Restores 30% of one ally's max HP, up to 140,000 HP.

items.name: Unreasonable Pick-Me-Up
items.text: Restores 30% of one ally's max HP, up to 300,000 HP.

items.name: Cup of Coffee
items.text: Restores 30% of one ally's max MP, up to 2,200 MP.

items.name: Double Espresso
items.text: Restores 30% of one ally's max MP, up to 10,000 MP.

items.name: Concerning Espresso
items.text: Restores 30% of one ally's max MP, up to 30,000 MP.

items.name: Chamomile Tea
items.text: One ally sheds 10 stress and loses 15% of their max MP: calm, and a little sleepy. Only the first cup a character drinks after each rest does anything.

items.name: Big Soft Hanky
items.text: Battle only. One ally has a good cry: they shed 25 stress and sit out their next turn.

items.name: Wriggle Oil
items.text: Removes every bind (head, arms and legs) from one ally.

items.name: Fresh Start Kit
items.text: Removes every bind, every debuff and every harmful status from one ally.

items.name: Smelling Salts
items.text: Ends one ally's Affliction or Virtue at once. If their stress is above 90 it drops to 90, so the next bad moment means a new Resolve Check.

items.name: Alarm Rooster
items.text: Revives a downed ally at 25% of max HP. Nobody enjoys it: they wake up with 10 stress that Willpower cannot reduce.

items.name: Camp Kit
items.text: Used up to make camp once, outside battle. Each character either Sleeps (restores 50% of max HP and MP) or Unwinds (sheds 30 stress). The price is one fight's gold at the party's level, 40 × level, so the price shown is for level 1.

items.name: Firecracker
items.text: Thrown at one enemy and rolled to hit. Power 4 fire damage from the thrower's Level (40 at most) and the benchmark attribute for that Level, against the target's Willpower.

items.name: Snowball
items.text: Thrown at one enemy and rolled to hit. Power 4 ice damage from the thrower's Level (40 at most) and the benchmark attribute for that Level, against the target's Willpower.

items.name: Static Sock
items.text: Thrown at one enemy and rolled to hit. Power 4 bolt damage from the thrower's Level (40 at most) and the benchmark attribute for that Level, against the target's Willpower.

items.name: Blessed Water Balloon
items.text: Thrown at one enemy and rolled to hit. Power 4 holy damage from the thrower's Level (40 at most) and the benchmark attribute for that Level, against the target's Willpower.

items.name: Ink Bomb
items.text: Thrown at one enemy and rolled to hit. Power 4 dark damage from the thrower's Level (40 at most) and the benchmark attribute for that Level, against the target's Willpower.

items.name: Bottled Bonfire
items.text: Thrown at one enemy and rolled to hit. Power 7 fire damage from the thrower's Level and the benchmark attribute for that Level, against the target's Willpower.

items.name: Bottled Blizzard
items.text: Thrown at one enemy and rolled to hit. Power 7 ice damage from the thrower's Level and the benchmark attribute for that Level, against the target's Willpower.

items.name: Bottled Thunder
items.text: Thrown at one enemy and rolled to hit. Power 7 bolt damage from the thrower's Level and the benchmark attribute for that Level, against the target's Willpower.

items.name: Bottled Sunrise
items.text: Thrown at one enemy and rolled to hit. Power 7 holy damage from the thrower's Level and the benchmark attribute for that Level, against the target's Willpower.

items.name: Bottled Midnight
items.text: Thrown at one enemy and rolled to hit. Power 7 dark damage from the thrower's Level and the benchmark attribute for that Level, against the target's Willpower.

items.name: Oven Mitts
items.text: One ally resists fire for 3 turns: fire damage ×0.5, or normal damage if they were weak to it.

items.name: Woolly Scarf
items.text: One ally resists ice for 3 turns: ice damage ×0.5, or normal damage if they were weak to it.

items.name: Rubber Boots
items.text: One ally resists bolt for 3 turns: bolt damage ×0.5, or normal damage if they were weak to it.

items.name: Tinted Spectacles
items.text: One ally resists holy for 3 turns: holy damage ×0.5, or normal damage if they were weak to it.

items.name: Night Light
items.text: One ally resists dark for 3 turns: dark damage ×0.5, or normal damage if they were weak to it.

items.name: Protein Biscuit
items.text: One ally has Might ×1.2 for 3 turns.

items.name: Clever Toffee
items.text: One ally has Arcana ×1.2 for 3 turns.

items.name: Jumping Beans
items.text: One ally has Finesse ×1.2 for 3 turns.

items.name: Second Breakfast
items.text: One ally has Constitution ×1.3 for 3 turns.

items.name: Nerve Tonic
items.text: One ally has Willpower ×1.3 for 3 turns.

items.name: Four-Leaf Clover
items.text: One ally has Luck ×1.3 for 3 turns.

items.name: Gristle Seed
items.text: Out of battle only. Permanent +5 Might, at most 10 of this seed per character. Gear and seeds together never add more than 200 to one attribute.

items.name: Bookworm Seed
items.text: Out of battle only. Permanent +5 Arcana, at most 10 of this seed per character. Gear and seeds together never add more than 200 to one attribute.

items.name: Fidget Seed
items.text: Out of battle only. Permanent +5 Finesse, at most 10 of this seed per character. Gear and seeds together never add more than 200 to one attribute.

items.name: Stodge Seed
items.text: Out of battle only. Permanent +5 Constitution, at most 10 of this seed per character. Gear and seeds together never add more than 200 to one attribute.

items.name: Mule Seed
items.text: Out of battle only. Permanent +5 Willpower, at most 10 of this seed per character. Gear and seeds together never add more than 200 to one attribute.

items.name: Fluke Seed
items.text: Out of battle only. Permanent +5 Luck, at most 10 of this seed per character. Gear and seeds together never add more than 200 to one attribute.

gearNote: A set is three pieces. The weapon costs the listed price and carries half the bonus. The armour costs 0.6 of the price and carries three tenths. The charm costs 0.4 of the price and carries a fifth. Each piece puts its points on one attribute, chosen at purchase. Gear and seeds together never add more than 200 to one attribute.
